properties.description:
Hold a joint needs-analysis session before proposing changes to the review and annotation surfaces. Establish how the user discovers, reads, compares and annotates a proposal in Review → Changes, follows feedback and revisions, and knows exactly which artifact version was reviewed.

Keep the original task brief separate from its deliverables. Proposal content must be a durable, traceable artifact, not task-description prose or a chat-only record. For this iteration the user requests a well-structured document with a table of contents, generated images and progressive disclosure. Determine the behaviors needed to review this example without making its format mandatory for other proposals.

Explore annotation targets in document text, images and expanded/collapsed content; changes between versions; feedback persistence and resolution; unsupported artifact types; and the visibility of consequences when an operation violates invariants or affects other relations. Record agreed needs and open questions in linked durable material. No design or implementation is accepted merely by holding this session.
properties.title: Analyze proposal-review and annotation needs with the user
